subject: Cloaker
picture: A large living cloak hangs flat against a dungeon wall like a manta ray. Two simple eye spots and a small mouth on the cloth. One long tail hangs from the bottom. No hanger, no person, no feet, no extra tails. Stone ceiling, block walls, large floor slabs, closed wooden door. Bold even black outlines on white, same look as locked I-01 and I-02.
